purpose: Deterministic pre-migration baseline for retrieval selection, callers/callees, impact, confidence, and snapshot identity over the protected corpus. Reusable by plans/020 without duplicating fixtures.

corpus_index.note: snapshot_id is per-build and not asserted; the file_count/unit_count and unit identities are the stable signals.

retrieval_selection.assert: both overloads resolve as distinct top_authority units; validate is pulled as graph_callee_neighbor

callers_callees.assert: both handle overloads independently resolve as callers of validate

snapshot_diff.expectation: rebuilding the unchanged corpus yields reuse / no semantic diff; editing OrderService#handle body must classify a changed unit, not a stale cache hit
snapshot_diff.note: captured as an expectation; a two-snapshot diff run is deferred to the stage that first exercises snapshot_diff against this corpus

observational_only.latency: not asserted; environment-sensitive. Reproduce via resolve_context/impact_analysis timing on the corpus index.
observational_only.snapshot_size: not asserted; captured only as unit_count=11 over 5 files. Fact-level evidence (Stage 3/4) is expected to grow this; measure then.
observational_only.rationale: plans/018 Risk [Medium] fact-level evidence expands snapshots. Latency and size are tracked as trends, not deterministic gates.
